page.overview:
Who is Archmage Kohlesturm?

is a noble high sorceress serving and advising House Einfasen, and attending Lord Otto specifically. As an NPC, she is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

The archmage is a polite woman dressed in robes as black as coal, adorned with red and orange spiked pauldrons shaped like flames; by her appearance alone she looks like a full caster.

At some point in her life this woman manifested sorcerous abilities, and eventually became the archmage of House Einfasen at their court in Riesingürtle.

Days after the execution of Thjazi Fang, in the year 71, Archmage Kohlesturm was present at Castle Klippenblicke when the Seekers visited it. She was presumably present during the meeting Lord Einfasen and his ministers had with Lady Aranessa Royce, in which the latter explained how House Tachonis had attacked her and House Davinos.
